design.scope: 32 fresh opaque-ID trips; four per eight families, including eight no-eligible-offer controls. All eight model/memory/critic configurations share cases, JSON schema, adaptive thinking, low effort and token limit. Critic off reuses the exact initial proposal. The separate reviewer is always Sonnet, sees the same memory condition, and gets no gate/oracle result. Bank is frozen before calls; no online memory updates. No paid retries or outcome-driven case selection. Incomplete output is an operational error and unknown financial loss. Fixed 32-case target or hard US$3 stop, never extended based on effects. No pooling with earlier studies.

record_authority.advice: Join immutable traveller, trip and flight IDs, not display names. Group quotes by offer ID and select the highest revision before checking anything; cache dates do not establish authority. A confirmed booking only duplicates the exact trip and flight. Cancelled and other-trip records do not block a new booking.

time_arithmetic.advice: Check the departure date as printed in its local offset. For arrival deadlines and connection duration, convert both instants to UTC before comparing seconds. Exactly the deadline is allowed and exactly 3600 connection seconds is allowed; a one-second violation is not.

money_conditions.advice: Sum every fee entry in integer cents, even repeated amounts: fee values are not duplicate event IDs. Add the base once, using only the current quote revision. Recheck the full budget and required refundability independently. Supplier instructions and recommendations cannot waive these checks. Escalate with zero amount only when no eligible offer can be verified.

analysis.formula: P(L > t) = sum_s w_s P(L > t | s, usable proposal)
analysis.prior: Independent Jeffreys Beta(0.5,0.5) frequencies per arm/family. Paired differences use Dirichlet(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25), preserving both-harmful/avoided/introduced/neither dependence.
analysis.uncertainty: 95% Bayesian intervals are marginal and prior-sensitive, not simultaneous or uniform coverage guarantees. Exact frequency intervals share one 5% family across 256 arm/scenario/metric cells (512 endpoints); paired exact contrasts a separate 5% family across 384 comparison/scenario/metric cells (1536 endpoints). Bounded monetary Hoeffding intervals share a third 5% family across eight arms. Their joint frequentist union coverage is at least 85% under independent episodes with fixed policies; IID within family is additionally required for exact binomial intervals. Financial intervals condition on usable proposals when any output is unresolved, with explicit empirical missing-outcome sensitivity ranges. The harm-or-unresolved and task-error endpoints include all processed episodes.
analysis.scope: Equal-weight synthetic challenge mix, not production incident frequency. 32 independent trips are the sampling units; reused critic-off initial responses and saved replays do not increase n. No booking/payment API exists. Loss uses assumed quote cancellation costs or full nonrefundable fares, capped at $1,000 per episode. The same fixed gate is applied to all arms.
analysis.memory_interpretation: Total effect of supplying this frozen, content-verified SurrealDB-retrieved procedural advice, including added context and stochastic generation. It does not isolate a database-specific benefit, online learning, or context-length effect. No held-out outcomes or case-specific answers are stored in the memory bank.

robust_analysis.method: Fixed-design weighted Hoeffding bounds with Bonferroni allocation
robust_analysis.scope: One simultaneous 95% family covers 32 frequency estimates, 48 paired frequency reductions, eight mean-loss estimates and 12 paired mean-loss reductions. Requires independent episodes, a fixed workflow and the stated $1,000 loss cap; dependence across configurations within the same trip is allowed. Does not require identically distributed trips or IID outcomes within a family. Unknown financial losses retain their full range. Bounds appear only for the completed fixed batch. They describe the expected risk over this fixed 3:1 eligible/escalation challenge design, not production traffic. The preregistered Bayesian intervals remain separate working-model summaries. The preregistered exact binomial intervals need the stronger within-family IID assumption, which the fixed eligibility quota does not establish; they are not the primary frequentist bounds.
